snippet.title: Session: Skate Sim | Throwdowns Update Out Now
snippet.description:
The latest update for Session: Skate Sim is live! 🛹

The Throwdowns Update introduces a small but immersive addition to your skating experience: brand-new throwdown animations. Watch your skater naturally drop the board to the ground, pick it up, and flow seamlessly into tricks like never before.

It’s a subtle touch, but one that makes every session feel even more real.

Session: Skate Sim is available now on PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC.

Download Session: Skate Sim on:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/861650/Session_Skate_Sim/
PlayStation ► https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10004240
Xbox ► https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/session-skate-sim/9N67P5D62MWZ
